reason: The case uses supported declarations, list and record construction, field access, and foreach over an array. Its asserted diagnostic rejects assigning an element of BType?[] to non-nilable BType; this is ordinary type compatibility checking within the supported constructs. No stated restriction excludes the nullable union, constant singleton union, record, or inferred-length array used here.
